The '''''Braha'tok''-class gunship''', also known as the '''Dornean gunship''', was an anti-[[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] constructed by the [[Dornean Braha'ket Fleetworks Conglomerate/Legends|Dornean Braha'ket Fleetworks Conglomerate]] for use by the independent [[Dornean Navy]]. Designed purely for military use, the ninety-[[Meter/Legends|meter]]-long craft bristled with weaponry, including [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] and [[Concussion missile launcher/Legends|concussion missile launchers]]. At first, the gunships were used to [[Dornea's war against the Empire|defend]] [[Dornea]] from the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], but in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], two of them were sent to [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]] to join [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar's]] [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Fleet]], which was poised to strike at the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] over the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]].

The two gunships were the ''[[Braha'tok]]'' and the ''[[Torktarak]]'', under the command of the [[Dornean/Legends|Dorneans]] [[Kiles L'toth]] and [[Etahn A'baht]], respectively. During the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], both of the [[Starship/Legends|ships]] engaged the Imperial [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|''Carrack''-class light cruiser]] [[Eminence (Carrack-class)|''Eminence'']], overcoming and destroying the enemy vessel. However, the ''Braha'tok'' was heavily damaged during the fighting, and Ackbar afterward ordered that it be scuttled. The Dorneans protested the order and had the ''Braha'tok'' shipped back to their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], where it served as a war [[Museum/Legends|museum]]. The ''Torktarak'' was also sent back to Dornea to continue its service in the Dornean [[Navy/Legends|Navy]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Rj_bgship1.png|thumb|left|250px|Multiple views of the ''Braha'tok''-class gunship]]
The ''Braha'tok''-class gunship&mdash;also known as the Dornean gunship&mdash;was designed purely for anti-[[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Space warfare/Legends|space warfare]] and manufactured by the [[Dornean Braha'ket Fleetworks Conglomerate/Legends|Dornean Braha'ket Fleetworks Conglomerate]] at the<ref name="Databank" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="GSWU">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Third Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref> [[Dornea/Legends|Dornea]], [[homeworld]] of the [[Dornean/Legends|Dornean]]<ref name="Databank" /> [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Etahn DB">{{DB|character|etahnabaht|A'baht, General Etahn}}</ref> Measuring ninety [[Meter/Legends|meters]], the [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] was long and narrow, and its bow had a [[Hammer (tool)/Legends|hammer]]-like crescent-shape, connected to the main [[Hull/Legends|hull]] by a thin neck. It also had two pairs of projections coming out of its port and starboard sides: the first pair toward its center, and the second, thinner pair on the ship's stern. In line with its space-combat-orientated design, the ''Braha'tok''-class gunship possessed no accommodations for [[Ground warfare/Legends|ground]]-based [[Soldier/Legends|infantry]], and included only a minimally spaced [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] deck.<ref name="Databank" />

The optimal crew number for the ''Braha'tok''-class gunship was 70 officers and enlisted crew, with operations such as [[Targeting computer/Legends|fire control]], maneuvering, and command centralized at stations within the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] bow. It was armed with 2 forward-mounted proton torpedo launchers, 4 forward-mounted concussion missile launchers, 2 twin-light [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] turrets, and 4 quad-laser cannons on the ventral and dorsal surfaces, 8 in total.<ref name="SS" /> The gunship was equipped with [[Engine/Legends|engines]], as well as a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] that was capable of making [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jumps between [[Star system/Legends|star systems]].<ref name="RotJ" />

==History==
===Use against the Empire===
[[File:Brahatok-class-gunship.jpg|thumb|right|300px|''Braha'tok''-class gunships joined the Rebel Fleet near Sullust before the Battle of Endor.]]
The ''Braha'tok''-class gunship was one of several ship classes produced by the Dornean Braha'ket Fleetworks Conglomerate at Dornea for the independent the [[Dornean Navy]], which had its own [[Dornea's war against the Empire|private war]] with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The [[Navy/Legends|navy]] successfully held off the Empire's [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] for several [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] asked the Dornean Navy to lend them [[Battleship/Legends|battleships]] for the Alliance's upcoming assault on the Empire's [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]]<ref name="Databank" /> [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]].<ref name="RotJ" /> In response, the navy sent a pair of ''Braha'tok''-class gunships ''[[Braha'tok]]'' and ''[[Torktarak]]'', respectively [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] by the Dorneans [[Kiles L'toth]] and [[Etahn A'baht]], to join with the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]]. The gunship class had been unseen outside the [[Realspace/Legends|space]] surrounding Dornea before that year, and so as to not arouse the suspicion of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]], the Dornean government claimed that the two ships being sent were undergoing a "shakedown cruise."<ref name="Databank" />

The pair of ''Braha'tok''-class gunships successfully met up with the Alliance Fleet<ref name="Databank" /> by the time it amassed at the planet [[Sullust]]. The [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] jumped into hyperspace together to travelled to the second [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star's]] construction site over the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. There, they were met by a substantial Imperial fleet under the command of Admiral [[Firmus Piett/Legends|Firmus Piett]], trapping them in the [[Endor system/Legends|system]]. The Alliance Fleet also discovered that the [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]] protecting the second Death Star, which was supposed to have been taken down by a [[Endor strike team|ground unit]] that had already landed on Endor, was still in effect.<ref name="RotJ" />

===Battle above Endor===
[[File:Battle_of_Endor.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A ''Braha'tok''-class gunship to the lower left of a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] during the Battle of Endor]]
During the resulting [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the second Death Star's [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]] destroyed the [[MC80 Liberty Type Heavy Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 ''Liberty'' type Star Cruiser]] [[Liberty/Legends|''Liberty'']],<ref name="RotJ" /> severely damaging or destroying several other Rebel craft in the ensuing explosion. As rescue craft scrambled to pick up the survivors, the ''Braha'tok'' moved into position to provide a defensive screen for the rescue craft. In doing so, the ''Braha'tok'' was engaged by the aging Imperial [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|''Carrack''-class light cruiser]] [[Eminence (Carrack-class)|''Eminence'']], a [[Warship/Legends|warship]] three times its size. In spite of the natural advantage that the ''Eminence'' possessed, L'toth was able to successfully hold the Imperials at bay for a [[Time/Legends|time]].<ref name="Databank" />

The ''Braha'tok'' eventually sustained heavy damage, prompting the ''Eminence'' to move in for the kill. Before it could do so, however, A'baht brought the ''Torktarak'' to the ''Braha'tok''{{'s}} aid, attacking the ''Eminence'' from the vessel's rear quarter. The ''Torktarak'' was able to destroy the Imperial craft and defend the waylaid ''Braha'tok'' as recovery operations continued.<ref name="Databank" /> The Alliance Fleet eventually destroyed the second Death Star and won the battle after the [[Battle station/Legends|battle station's]] deflector shield was taken down.<ref name="RotJ" />

Following the Battle of Endor, the ''Torktarak'', which had received minimal damage, returned to Dornea to continue its service in the Dornean Navy. When Admiral Ackbar ordered that the severely damaged ''Braha'tok'' be scuttled, the Dornean Navy protested the decision and had the craft shipped back to Dornea, where it was converted to serve as a war [[Museum/Legends|museum]].<ref name="Databank" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Braha'tok''-class gunship originally appeared as a background model in [[Richard Marquand]]'s film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], during the "Battle of Endor" sequence. During production, the [[Wikipedia:Kitbashing|kit-bashed]] model seen in the film was known only as the "ROJ BG ship."<ref name="MSS">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/photoreceptor/2003/06/photoreceptor20030606.html|series=Photoreceptor|text=Mystery Ship Solved}}</ref> In [[2006]], the ship was identified and elaborated on in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (original)|Databank]] by StarWars.com member "[[Ello137]]" through the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] feature "[[What's The Story?]]"<ref name="Databank" />

Ello137 saw the "What's the Story?" competition as an opportunity to tie obscure elements of the [[Star Wars Legends|Expanded Universe]] with background elements from the movies, prompting his use of the Dornean Navy from ''[[The Black Fleet Crisis]]'' novel trilogy by [[Michael P. Kube-McDowell]]. Initially, Ello137 conceived of the names ''Braha'tok'' and ''Torktarak'' as mythical Dornean names, but he was unable to fit the information into his final entry. The element of the Alliance searching for craft from independent navies was inspired by scenes from [[A. C. Crispin]]'s [[The Han Solo Trilogy (hardcover)|''The Han Solo Trilogy'']].<ref name="Ello Blog">{{Blog|apocalypselater|16/comments|What's the Story, Ello137? Funny you should ask &hellip;}}</ref>

To determine the size of the gunship, Ello137 studied a brief shot in ''Return of the Jedi'' in which the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] flies past the gunship, and made comparisons. For the ''Carrack''-class [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] that the gunships battle at Endor, Ello137 wanted to use a craft that had already been established in [[Canon|continuity]]. In doing so, he selected the ''Eminence'', a craft identified in [[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|''The Essential Chronology'']] as having fought at the [[Battle of ThonBoka]]. Remembering depictions of the battle in the book showing ''Carrack''-class cruisers, Ello137 incorrectly assumed that the ''Eminence'' was of that class; it was in fact a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]]. Realizing his mistake after submitting the entry, Ello137 attempted to resubmit, this time using the [[Integrity (Carrack-class)/Legends|''Integrity'']] from [[Matthew Stover]]'s novelization of [[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith'']].<ref name="Ello Blog" /> The original entry was the one selected by StarWars.com. The information from the Databank entry was later used for [[2008]]'s ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', for its own entry on the ''Braha'tok''-class gunship.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|106|''Braha'tok''-class gunship}}</ref>
